1.asv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

2.web: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
2.asv: How long will ye hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

3.web: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?
3.asv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, Andare become unclean in your sight?

4.web: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?
4.asv: Thou that tearest thyself in thine anger, Shall the earth be forsaken for thee? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?

5.web: “Yes, the light of the wicked shall be put out, The spark of his fire shall not shine.
5.asv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, And the spark of his fire shall not shine.

6.web: The light shall be dark in his tent. His lamp above him shall be put out.
6.asv: The light shall be dark in his tent, And his lamp above him shall be put out.

7.web: The steps of his strength shall be shortened. His own counsel shall cast him down.
7.asv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, And his own counsel shall cast him down.

8.web: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.
8.asv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, And he walketh upon the toils.

9.web: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.
9.asv: A gin shall take him by the heel, Anda snare shall lay hold on him.

10.web: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.
10.asv: A noose is hid for him in the ground, And a trap for him in the way.

11.web: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall chase him at his heels.
11.asv: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, And shall chase him at his heels.

12.web: His strength shall be famished. Calamity shall be ready at his side.
12.asv: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, And calamity shall be ready at his side.

13.web: The members of his body shall be devoured. The firstborn of death shall devour his members.
13.asv: The members of his body shall be devoured, Yea, the first-born of death shall devour his members.

14.web: He shall be rooted out of his tent where he trusts. He shall be brought to the king of terrors.
14.asv: He shall be rooted out of his tent wherein he trusteth; And he shall be brought to the king of terrors.

15.web: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur shall be scattered on his habitation.
15.asv: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his: Brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

16.web: His roots shall be dried up beneath. Above shall his branch be cut off.
16.asv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, And above shall his branch be cut off.

17.web: His memory shall perish from the earth. He shall have no name in the street.
17.asv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, And he shall have no name in the street.

18.web: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
18.asv: He shall be driven from light into darkness, And chased out of the world.

19.web: He shall have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
19.asv: He shall have neither son nor son’s son among his people, Nor any remaining where he sojourned.

20.web: Those who come after shall be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.
20.asv: They that come after shall be astonished at his day, As they that went before were affrighted.

21.web: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
21.asv: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous, And this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
